name: copy-button
title: Copy Button
description: A native <button> that writes an associated string (snippet, API key, URL) to the clipboard with the Async Clipboard API, then flips to a transient aria-live "Copied" state. Progressive-enhancement fallback for non-secure contexts. Ships in five flavours: Hono JSX (TypeScript), Jinja2 macro, Go html/template, Phoenix function component, and a raw HTML snippet. Follows the WAI-ARIA APG button pattern.

files.content: defmodule ShadcnHtmx.Components.CopyButton do @moduledoc """ Copy Button — shadcn-htmx, htmx v4 + Tailwind v4 for Phoenix. Mirrors registry/ui/copy-button.tsx so a Phoenix LiveView project renders the same markup our docs site renders. Works with plain HEEx too — htmx attributes pass through via `:rest`. Click-to-copy: writes `value` (or the text of the element named by `copy_target`) to the clipboard via the Async Clipboard API, then flips to a transient "Copied" state announced through an empty aria-live region. The shared behaviour ships in site.js. Sources: * repos/mdn/files/en-us/web/api/clipboard/writetext/index.md * repos/web.dev/src/site/content/en/patterns/clipboard/copy-text/index.md * repos/mdn/files/en-us/web/accessibility/aria/reference/attributes/aria-live/index.md ## Examples <.copy_button value="npm i shadcn-htmx" /> <.copy_button copy_target="api-key" size="icon" aria-label="Copy API key" /> Native ` """ end end
